articles.title: How to Beat Volvagia | Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Boss Fight - IGN
articles.summary: Volvagia, the Subterranean Lava Dragon, is the boss of the Fire Temple in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake. This terrifying dragon uses the lava pools throughout its lair to ambush Link, unleashing powerful fire attacks and attempting to catch you off guard. To defeat it, you'll need to use your Megaton Hammer to smash its helmet and expose the vulnerable spot on its forehead.During the battle, Volvagia will also take to the air, breathing streams of fire across the arena and causing burning meteors to rain down from the ceiling. Learn how to avoid its attacks, recognize its fake-outs, and time your hammer strikes to bring down the dragon and claim your Heart Container.

articles.title: How to Beat Phantom Ganon | Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Gameplay Walkthrough - IGN
articles.summary: Phantom Ganon is the boss of the Forest Temple in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake. This evil spirit takes the form of Ganondorf and challenges Adult Link to a two-phase battle. First, you'll need to identify the real Phantom Ganon among his copies as they emerge from the paintings surrounding the arena, using your Fairy Bow to knock him off his horse.In the second phase, Phantom Ganon abandons his horse and attacks with powerful magic projectiles. You'll need to use your Master Sword to deflect his energy orbs back at him, stunning him long enough to rush in with jump attacks and Spin Attacks. Follow our boss guide to learn how to recognize his attacks, avoid his tricks, and defeat Phantom Ganon to earn your Heart Container and the Forest Medallion.
